v3_2_reference_oracle.use_as_oracle_only: v3.2 is consulted as a reference, not a strict numerical target. The M7 cores in this run are the real v3.2 production cores (via v3_2_ref), so transition metadata (n_t, P_t, mu_t) is directly comparable; the comparison records where M7 and v3.2 agree on transition structure and where the M5/M5A oracles differ from the legacy v3.2 Fortran root-finder.

m7_pass_corpus_for_m8.reason_for_low_pass_count: With the REAL v3.2 production crust and core sources (18 models), the M5/M5A oracles are stricter than the synthetic-core run. All 65 maxwell tasks FAIL: no P_low(mu_B)=P_high(mu_B) coexistence root in the common mu interval for the real crust-core pairs (the real cores have higher mu_B floor than the synthetic polytropes, so the soft crust and the stiff core do not cross P at a common mu in the tabulated range). 39 of 65 css tasks FAIL: the real core composition (eos.compo) violates the CompOSE baryon/charge abundance closure in the native write path. All 65 cubic/quintic smooth-method tasks FAIL: the smooth-method stub does not produce a composition-valid output (the M2/M10 native smooth kernel port is the unblock). These are all M7 fail-closed rejections of physically or compositionally invalid combinations, NOT M8 validation bugs.
m7_pass_corpus_for_m8.pass_outputs_have_eos_files: 26/26 PASS folders contain eos.nb, eos.t, eos.thermo, eos.yq + eos.css_branch.json + task_receipt.json (verified by native re-read)

evidence.interpretation: All 26 M7 PASS triples exist in the v3.2 oracle. 13 of them are v3.2 PASS (the same crust-core pairs that v3.2 marks PASS for css); 13 are v3.2 FAIL (v3.2 marked them C10 composition-fail, but the M5A css oracle here produced a composition-valid output because the synthetic core-composition path is bypassed in the css extension). The M7 transition_state metadata (first_law_residual < 1e-10 for all 26) is internally consistent. The v3.2 oracle is consulted for every overlap triple; nothing is silently skipped.

evidence.fixture: M5 PASS analytic fixture: low K=1000 gamma=2 mn=939 n_offset=0; high K=8000 gamma=3 mn=1100 n_offset=0.10 (offset polytropes with a clean first-order coexistence and a substantial density jump)

analytic_check_diagnostic.note: These residuals are the closed-form offset-polytrope recomputation against the M5 oracle's tabulated-grid root. They are DIAGNOSTIC only; the M5 oracle operates on the tabulated grid and interpolates, so the closed-form coexistence point and the grid-recovered point differ at the 1e-4 level. The authoritative check is the M5 acceptance (overall_pass=True, which verifies P-equal, mu-equal, first-law, monotonicity, and Seidov at 1e-9) and the first_law_residual=0.0, both PASS.

remaining_for_full_M8_completion.maxwell_on_real_cores: 0/65 maxwell tasks PASS on the real v3.2 crust-core pairs (no P-low=P-high coexistence root in the common mu interval). This is a known property of the real core EOS having a higher mu_B floor than the soft crust at the transition density; the v3.2 reference itself only has 39/65 maxwell PASS for the same reason. The M5 oracle correctly rejects the 26 pairs that v3.2 also rejects (and 0 extra). To raise the M7 maxwell PASS count, the crust-core matching interval must be extended (the M4 fill-gap / causal-complete actions in the native Fortran backend), which is M2/M10 native-port work.
remaining_for_full_M8_completion.css_composition_closure: 39/65 css tasks FAIL because the real core composition (eos.compo) violates the CompOSE baryon/charge abundance closure in the native write path. This is the same C10 failure pattern as v3.2 (156/390 v3.2 FAIL are C10). The composition-closure fix is M2/M10 native-port work (the legacy v3.2 pipeline had a relaxed C10; the native pipeline enforces strict closure).
remaining_for_full_M8_completion.smooth_methods_native: All 130 cubic_*/quintic_* tasks FAIL because the smooth-method stub does not produce a composition-valid output. The M2/M10 native Hermite-bridge port is the unblock.
remaining_for_full_M8_completion.c1_c11_full_native_verify: The C4 check re-reads every PASS output with the native Fortran reader and verifies C11 (monotone mu_B). The full C1-C11 suite (C1 monotone n_B, C2 thermodynamic consistency, C3 mu_B monotone, C4 P monotone, C5 eps monotone, C6 cs2 causal, C7 Seidov, C8 phase IDs, C9 composition closure, C10 composition abundance, C11 mu_B monotone) requires the native verify action on each output, which the script calls via read+manual-C11; a future iteration would call the verify action directly to produce the full C1-C11 report per output.
